notes: FICTIONAL example for testing the format. Not a real card or offer.

sources.title: Example Bank – Sample Rewards card benefits

items.label: Foreign currency markup 3.5%
items.clause: Foreign currency transaction fee: 3.5% of the transaction amount.

items.label: 1% fuel surcharge waiver on ₹400–₹4,000
items.clause: 1% fuel surcharge waiver on transactions between Rs 400 and Rs 4,000.

pointValue.clause: 1 reward point = Rs 0.25 when redeemed against statement balance.

earnRules.label: 2 points per ₹100 on all spends
earnRules.clause: Earn 2 reward points for every Rs 100 spent.

earnRules.label: 10 points per ₹100 online, up to 2,500 points a month
earnRules.clause: 5X reward points on online spends, capped at 2,500 accelerated points per statement cycle.

earnRules.label: 5% cashback on groceries, up to ₹500 a month
earnRules.clause: 5% cashback on grocery spends, maximum Rs 500 per month.

exclusions.label: No rewards or milestone credit on fuel, rent, wallet loads
exclusions.clause: Fuel, rent and wallet load transactions are not eligible for reward points or spend milestones.

offers.label: 10% instant discount at Croma, up to ₹1,500
offers.clause: 10% instant discount up to Rs 1,500 on minimum transaction of Rs 15,000.

offers.label: ₹100 off on Instamart orders above ₹999 (Signature only)
offers.clause: Flat Rs 100 off on orders above Rs 999, twice a month, Signature variant only.

offers.label: Old summer travel offer
offers.clause: 12% cashback up to Rs 2,000 on flights.

milestones.label: Annual fee waived on ₹1,50,000 spend in a card year
milestones.benefit: Next year's ₹500 annual fee is waived.
milestones.clause: Annual fee waived on spends of Rs 1,50,000 or more in the preceding card membership year.

milestones.label: Spend ₹10,000 in the previous quarter to unlock lounge access
milestones.benefit: Unlocks 1 domestic lounge visit next quarter.
milestones.clause: Spend of Rs 10,000 in the previous calendar quarter is required for complimentary lounge access.

lounge.label: 1 domestic lounge visit per quarter
lounge.clause: 1 complimentary domestic lounge visit per calendar quarter, subject to the spend condition.

otherBenefits.label: Card liability cover
otherBenefits.detail: Covers fraudulent transactions reported within 48 hours, up to the limit in the terms.
